title: Auto-Sizing Node Inventory and Burndown Tracker
description: Format a team's AST node list into a Markdown table with dynamically sized columns and list all remaining TODO evaluator methods.

steps.description: Define NODES with seven 4-tuples (NodeClass, fields, grammar_rule, evaluator_method), marking Num, Var, and BinOp with their eval_* functions and Let, If, While, and Call as 'TODO'.
Compute widths as the maximum cell length in each column across NODES and HEADER, then print the header, separator, and every row in NODES.

steps.question: Which nodes does the list comprehension on line 25 collect into todo?
steps.answer: It selects every row where n[3] == 'TODO', collecting Let, If, While, and Call so 3 of 7 nodes are wired end to end.

steps.description: Filter NODES for 'TODO' entries, print how many nodes are wired end to end, and list the node names still to implement.
Inspect todo on line 29 as the script prints 'Still to implement: Let, If, While, Call'.
